summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting preliminary domestic Vietnam deliveries of 24,774 electric vehicles in April 2026, with year-to-date deliveries of 78,458 EVs. The filing provides a breakdown by model and reaffirms market leadership. This is a routine operational update on delivery metrics, not a special situation. No transaction, corporate action, or event triggering any special-situations category is described. The Form 6-K is an ordinary current report by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16.
